title: Heat Check, Week 6
dek: Kimani Vidal's snap share has climbed five straight weeks. The stove's on in Los Angeles.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Wed 4:55 PM ET: Rhamondre Stevenson moves up to RB12 for me vs NYJ and Brenton Strange to TE12 vs HOU, a borderline start; Kendrick Bourne is WR36 @LAR, a low-end WR3. Woody Marks is RB20 and Germie Bernard WR34.

Updated Tue 6:00 PM ET: Germie Bernard ran 28 routes vs IND, tied for Pittsburgh's high, with a team-high 9 targets; he is still WR34 for me @TB and a claim at 3 to 6 percent of FAAB.

Heat Check is about direction, not box scores. A riser earned more of the ball week over week or got a new role you can see in the snap counts; a faller is losing snaps, routes or targets. One number backs each call, lineup calls are this week's Menu rank, other ranks are rest of season for me, and the scoring is PPR.
outro_md: Butcher Shop turns these trends into trade offers, and the Menu has every one of them ranked for Week 6.

risers.why: Kimani Vidal (LAC) led the Chargers' backs with 28 snaps vs DEN and ran 8 times for 57 and a TD, while Omarion Hampton played 30 percent. His snap share has climbed five straight weeks.
risers.verdict: RB61 rest of season for me, a deep-league add. Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

risers.why: Rhamondre Stevenson (NE) played 71 percent of the snaps vs LV, ran 13 times for 64 and a TD and caught 3 for 21. TreVeyon Henderson will miss multiple weeks with a high ankle sprain.
risers.verdict: RB12 for me vs NYJ, borderline RB1/RB2 this week.

risers.why: Bhayshul Tuten (JAX) ran a career-high 22 times vs PHI and played 87.5 percent of the early downs, up from 71 percent. Chris Rodriguez Jr. is now the handcuff and LeQuint Allen Jr. keeps third downs.
risers.verdict: RB18 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench back.
risers.price: a WR3 and a bench back

risers.stat: 20 targets on 90% of snaps in Week 5
risers.why: Malik Nabers (NYG) drew 20 targets @WAS and caught 11 for 121 and a TD. Jameis Winston threw 54 times and went to Nabers on more than a third of them.
risers.verdict: WR7 for me vs NO this week.

risers.why: Isaiah Likely (NYG) caught 11 of 13 for 94 and 2 TDs @WAS, the top tight end score of the week. His snap share climbed every week through Week 3, and Winston has made him the No. 2 target.
risers.verdict: TE4 for me vs NO this week.

risers.why: Woody Marks (HOU) played 47 of the 48 snaps after David Montgomery left @TEN, ran 15 times for 62 and caught 4 of 4. Montgomery is week to week with the groin.
risers.verdict: RB20 for me @JAX this week, an RB2. Claim him, 15 to 25 percent of FAAB.

risers.stat: Snaps 17 in Week 3 to 92% in Week 5
risers.why: Germie Bernard (PIT) drew a team-high 9 targets vs IND and caught 6 for 80, and ran 28 routes, tied for the team high. Michael Pittman Jr. is on IR and Roman Wilson is out multiple weeks.
risers.verdict: WR34 for me @TB, a low-end WR3. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB.

risers.why: Brenton Strange (JAX) caught 14 of 16 targets for 163 over Weeks 4 and 5, a 26.2 percent target share. He led Jacksonville with 8 targets @CIN.
risers.verdict: TE12 for me vs HOU, a borderline start this week. Claim him, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB.

risers.why: Tyjae Spears (TEN) out-snapped Tony Pollard 34 to 30 vs HOU and caught 9 of 9 targets. It was his first game over half the snaps this season.
risers.verdict: RB40 for me @IND, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

risers.why: Puka Nacua (LAR) caught 17 of 24 targets for 138 and a TD vs BUF, a week after 9 for 125 in his first game since Week 1. Matthew Stafford threw 54 times and Nacua took 44 percent of the targets.
risers.verdict: First among receivers for me vs ARI this week.

risers.stat: Carries 17, 11, 18; 18 of 22 RB carries in Week 5
risers.why: J.K. Dobbins (DEN) took 18 of the 22 running back carries @LAC for 68 and a TD. RJ Harvey had 3 carries and 1 target a week after catching 10.
risers.verdict: RB27 for me vs SEA, a high-end RB3, a high-end flex play.

risers.stat: Snap share 80% to 87%, a season high
risers.why: Aaron Jones Sr. (MIN) played 87 percent of the snaps @NO and ran 25 times for 113 and a TD. Jordan Mason cannot come off IR until Week 7.
risers.verdict: RB32 rest of season for me. Trade for him during the bye; offer a bench RB.

risers.stat: Snaps 55% in Week 3; team-high 70 yards in Week 5
risers.why: Kendrick Bourne (ARI) caught 5 of 8 for 70 vs DET with Marvin Harrison Jr. inactive, and Harrison is now in Houston. Bourne is the No. 2 receiver next to Michael Wilson.
risers.verdict: WR36 for me @LAR, a low-end WR3 and a low-end flex play. Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

risers.stat: 10 targets in Week 3, 9 in Week 5, plus a goal-line carry
risers.why: Tyler Warren (IND) caught 7 of 9 for 83 @PIT, tied for the team lead in targets, and scored on a 1-yard run. He is the target leader with Alec Pierce on IR.
risers.verdict: TE5 for me vs TEN this week.

fallers.why: Omarion Hampton (LAC) played 30 percent of the snaps vs DEN, third of three backs, though his 14 carries went for 33. He has 3 targets all season behind a line missing Rashawn Slater and Joe Alt.
fallers.verdict: RB14 rest of season for me. Monitor; his snap share @KC Sunday.

fallers.why: Ashton Jeanty (LV) played 53 percent of the snaps @NE and 27 percent of the third downs, down from 70.5 percent in Weeks 1 to 4, as Dylan Laube took 7 opportunities. Klint Kubiak said Jeanty is beat up.
fallers.verdict: RB8 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

fallers.why: RJ Harvey (DEN) had 3 carries and 1 target @LAC, a week after catching 10 of 10. J.K. Dobbins took 18 of the 22 running back carries.
fallers.verdict: RB33 rest of season for me. Monitor; Thursday night's snap split vs SEA.
fallers.watch: Thursday night's snap split vs SEA

fallers.why: Jeremiyah Love (ARI) ran 12 times for 22 with 1 target vs DET, and Tyler Allgeier kept the passing downs. Arizona also lost left tackle Paris Johnson Jr. for the season.
fallers.verdict: RB15 rest of season for me. Monitor; his carries @LAR Sunday.

fallers.why: Tony Pollard (TEN) played fewer snaps than Tyjae Spears vs HOU for the first time this season and ran 14 times for 52. Spears caught all 9 of his targets.
fallers.verdict: RB30 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR3.

fallers.why: Brian Thomas Jr. (JAX) caught none of his 3 targets vs PHI while Parker Washington drew 9. He leaves the field in 12 personnel.
fallers.verdict: WR42 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR3.

fallers.stat: 10 catches for 66 yards in four games outside Week 2
fallers.why: Jaylen Waddle (DEN) drew 7 targets in Week 3 and caught 2 for 10. Courtland Sutton ran a route on 94 percent of the dropbacks that week to Waddle's 82.
fallers.verdict: WR15 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR3 who gets targets.

fallers.stat: Targets 13 without Nacua, 7 with him back
fallers.why: Davante Adams (LAR) drew 7 targets vs BUF while Puka Nacua drew 24. Adams scored twice, and that is what is holding up his price.
fallers.verdict: WR25 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR2.

fallers.why: Jaylen Wright (MIA) ran 6 times for 11 vs CIN while Ollie Gordon II played 43 snaps and ran 18 times. Gordon has 27 carries to Wright's 11 over Weeks 4 and 5.
fallers.verdict: RB57 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

fallers.stat: 46 of 59 snaps in Week 4, 2 targets in Week 5
fallers.why: Keon Coleman (BUF) caught 1 of 2 targets @LAR with DJ Moore out, a week after 6 of 7 for 116. Khalil Shakir and Ty Johnson took the volume Monday.
fallers.verdict: WR83 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

fallers.why: Alvin Kamara (NO) played 12 snaps vs MIN with a back injury and ran 3 times for 12. Kendre Miller led New Orleans with 10 carries.
fallers.verdict: RB45 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

fallers.why: Tyler Higbee (LAR) caught 5 of 6 for 83 vs BUF, but his volume fell once Puka Nacua came back. Terrance Ferguson has been out with the ankle since Week 3.
fallers.verdict: TE38 rest of season for me. Monitor; Terrance Ferguson's practice reports this week.
fallers.watch: Terrance Ferguson's practice reports this week

fallers.stat: One starting lineman left from September
fallers.why: Justin Herbert (LAC) threw for 121 yards vs DEN and has no 15-point game in five tries. Rashawn Slater is on IR and Joe Alt is hurt.
fallers.verdict: QB16 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR and a streaming QB.
fallers.price: a bench WR and a streaming QB
